correctness.rationale: The cyclic local eigenvalue recurrences eliminate sites with unit coefficients and give the exact 2x2 module presentation. Smith factors recover every kernel of s^k(s^m-1), and inclusion-exclusion by Möbius inversion gives exact first-entry/period counts. At s=0 defect parity proves invertibility and nullity. The Fibonacci doubling identity yields exactly s^n at two infinite families; odd-length kernel dimension one forces a single nilpotent Jordan block of size n. Both independent software checks were executed successfully; finite checks are corroboration, not infinity proof.

value.rationale: A sparse two-defect perturbation of a canonical additive cellular automaton has sharp placement-controlled reversibility, two infinite full-extinction resonances and all-period transient counts, giving structural insight into how very local feedback changes global finite dynamics. This is more informative than a small empirical table, a mere normalization, or the homogeneous/one-defect known results.
